title: eludite/test/discover
description: Discover the tests of the open solution's test projects, or of the projects named, out of process (brief 0035; host-rpc.md, "Tests"). Each test project is found by reading its project file (TestProjectInspector: MTP or VSTest) and becomes one container per target framework. MTP containers run the test application with `--server --client-port <port>` and send `testing/discoverTests`; VSTest containers each by a vstest.console of their own (`TestDiscovery.Start`); containers are discovered side by side. The host answers at once with the discovery's id and its containers, then streams eludite/test/update notifications (`discovered`, `output`, `containerFinished`) and ends with exactly one `finished`. Discovery reads the build outputs as they are: the shell builds first when it wants a fresh build.

projects.description: Absolute paths of test projects of the open solution to discover. Omitted: every test project the solution lists (projects that are not test projects are left out).

configuration.description: The configuration whose build outputs hold the tests, for example Debug or Release. Omitted: Debug.

runSettings.description: Absolute path of a .runsettings file (the setting test.runSettings): VSTest gets its contents as the RunSettings of every request; MTP gets it as `--settings <path>` on the test application's command line. Omitted: none.

vstestConsolePath.description: The vstest.console.dll to run (the setting test.vstestConsolePath). Omitted: the one in the .NET SDK `dotnet --list-sdks` lists last (the SDK the host runs on when it has one).

runId.description: The discovery's or run's id, unique within one host process, from 1 (discoveries and runs share one counter).

generation.description: The solution generation it runs under. A new generation (another solution opened, or this one closed) cancels it.

containers.description: The containers being discovered, in solution order (a multi-targeted project's frameworks in the project file's order).

container.description: One test container: a test project built for one target framework (a multi-targeted project is one container per framework, as Visual Studio's Test Explorer lists it).

id.description: A test container: one test project built for one target framework, named `<absolute project path>|<target framework>`.

name.description: As the Test Explorer shows it: the project's name, with the target framework in parentheses when the project has several (`Corpus.XunitV3 (net10.0)`).

project.description: Absolute path of the project file.

protocol.description: mtp: Microsoft.Testing.Platform's server mode (JSON-RPC between the host and the test application). vstest: the VSTest translation-layer protocol to vstest.console, for projects that have not migrated.

runtime.description: What runs the tests: dotnet (the apphost or `dotnet <dll>`), mono (`mono <exe>` for .NET Framework off Windows, the located Mono), netfx (the .exe on Windows).

program.description: MTP: the test application (the apphost, the DLL or the .exe). VSTest: the test assembly vstest.console loads (its source).

error.description: Why the container cannot be discovered or run (`not built: ... does not exist; build the project first`, `.NET Framework tests need Mono off Windows`). Such a container has no tests; its containerFinished update says failed with this message.
